name: diezmossv
description: Cloudflare Worker and admin panel for automated CDE issuance from Wompi donations.

scripts.cf:migrate:staging: node scripts/d1-migration-preflight.mjs --database diezmossv-staging-resource-example --env staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply diezmossv-staging-resource-example --env staging --remote
scripts.cf:deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging --keep-vars
scripts.cf:migrate:prod: node scripts/d1-migration-preflight.mjs --database diezmossv-production-resource-example --env production && wrangler d1 migrations apply diezmossv-production-resource-example --env production --remote
scripts.cf:deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production --keep-vars
